gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Expressive from the start, Bushcraft draws every curve like a marker, while Noto Sans Ogham stands tall beside it. The marker-line against those tall, bold-looking lowercase bodies is the draw.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-ol-chi: Wide-spaced and wire-like, Bushcraft holds a steady line weight through every curve. Noto Sans Ol Chiki pulls its curve tails back, so words settle into solid blocks over a full page of text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-hu: Bushcraft's line never changes weight, and its characters sit far apart, with capitals barely standing out from lowercase. Noto Sans Old Hungarian opens its counters wide, easing the closed heading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-it: Bushcraft runs a single stroke width through the entire alphabet. Noto Sans Old Italic, with lowercase nearly reaching capital height, makes that single line the sharpest thing on the page.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-no: Expressive Bushcraft spaces its letters wide and never shifts weight. Make the heading small and its wide spacing loosens, while Noto Sans Old North Arabian keeps a dense, tall lowercase band.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-tu: Wide-spaced and wiry, Bushcraft does one thing best: holding a single line width through every last turn of a letter. Noto Sans Old Turkic does chunky, tall lowercase best, with open-mouthed curves that stay clear.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-osage: Bent-wire rounds with wide spacing: that is Bushcraft all over. It does round, constant lines best, while Noto Sans Osage fills each line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping open curves.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-pahawh: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sets a high x-height guide, and its rounds gap open like a cracked bangle. Bushcraft supplies the wiry, wide-spaced heading, with horizontals as stout as verticals.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-pau-ci: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau keeps its curves open-ended, with only a short step from lowercase top to capital top. And paragraphs of it read with room to breathe beneath Bushcraft's rope-thin outline.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-phoeni: Noto Sans Phoenician stands tall, its s curves opening wide at both ends. Beside it, Bushcraft's laser-etched, constant-width line and wide spacing make that generous lowercase height the pair's clearest quality.
